lines.en: Tail, forward, tail again.
Water slips past my gills, cool and slow.
The whole school turns at once.
Don't bump me, I'm swimming steady.

lines.zh: 深海的水压得我眼皮沉。
lines.en: The deep presses my eyelids down.
Swimming near the sand saves effort.
Cold current. I'm heading into it.
A little higher. It's brighter up there.
I turn slowly. Don't rush me.
The school behind me follows my lead.
Kelp brushing past my fin.
Crossed a whole stretch of warm water.
Reef ahead. Going around.

lines.zh: 游了这么久，才挪了一点。
lines.en: All this swimming, barely any distance.

lines.zh: 前面那群鱼又换了方向。
lines.en: The school ahead has turned again.

lines.zh: 我摆尾慢了半拍，落在后面。
lines.en: My tail beats half a beat late, and I fall behind.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: Hovering still, gills opening and closing.
The light up there makes me stare.
Nothing new down here.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，看它升上去。
lines.en: Blew a bubble. Watched it rise.

lines.zh: 这一层水刚好，不冷不热。
lines.en: This depth is just right. Not cold, not warm.
Two flicks of the fin to hold still.
A boat shadow passed overhead.

lines.zh: 我数了数同伴，少了一条。
lines.en: Counted my school. One short.

lines.zh: 沙子里有只螃蟹在横着走。
lines.en: A crab is walking sideways in the sand.
Mouth open, letting the current through.
So quiet, only water sound.

lines.zh: 我在石头边上歇一会儿。
lines.en: Resting by this rock a while.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片反着一点蓝光。
lines.en: My scales catch a little blue light.
Too dark in the deep. Not going.
Why are you watching me from up there?

lines.zh: 我隔着水面看你，你变形了。
lines.en: Through the surface you look warped.
Your shadow is lying on the seafloor.
That rod in your hand. I know it.
I'm not coming ashore. You come down.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛贴在水面上，像两块石头。
lines.en: Your eyes on the surface look like two stones.
Every step you take shakes the water.
Tilting sideways to get a look at you.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，很干，很奇怪。
lines.en: You stand on land. Dry. Strange.
Are you going to put me in a bucket?
One of my scales came off.
The water's full of my scent now.
Hurts so much my gills shut.
Who touched me? Sinking down.
I thrashed around twice.
That one really stung.
Hiding in the kelp.
My tail's not answering right.
I'm swimming crooked now.
Please, not another one.

lines.zh: 那钩上的东西在动，很可疑。
lines.en: That thing on the hook is wiggling. Suspicious.
Bait? I'll circle it first.
Coming closer. Just a little.
Smells edible. I'm not that dumb.
You're jigging that rod wrong.
The school backed off. So will I.

lines.zh: 那一小团东西，值得冒险吗？
lines.en: Is that little lump worth the risk?
Mouth open. Not biting yet.

lines.zh: 水里的碎屑比钩子安全。
lines.en: Scraps in the water are safer than hooks.
Keep wiggling that and I'll really leave.
Who bumped me? My scales are out of line.
You're huge. Why squeeze past me?
You've stirred up the whole current.
Move over, my gills are blocked.

lines.zh: 撞过来的时候，我听见闷响。
lines.en: Heard a dull thud when you hit me.
Backing off half a tail length.
Not the net, I'm tangled.
Squeezed right into a rock.
The water went cloudy.
One tail flick and I'm gone.
You're in this warm water too?
Let's swim side by side a while.
Your tail beats steadier than mine.

lines.zh: 这片沙底够安静，就这儿。
lines.en: This sandy bottom's quiet. Here.

lines.zh: 别急，先跟着鱼群转两圈。
lines.en: Easy. Two laps with the school first.
Wait till the water warms a little.

lines.zh: 你的鳞色在深水里真好看。
lines.en: Your scales look fine in the deep.

lines.zh: 水温变了，我们换个地方。
lines.en: Water's shifting. Let's move.
This reef is ours from now on.

lines.zh: 别贴上来了，我还没想好。
lines.en: Don't crowd me, I haven't decided.
Something's sinking. I'll catch it.
Small enough to swallow.
Chewed twice. No taste.
Mine. I saw it first.
Got a mouthful of sand too.
Too hard. Spitting it out.

lines.zh: 沉到水底的我都要试一口。
lines.en: Anything on the bottom gets a taste test.
Holding it in my mouth, swallowing slow.
Someone threw something in.
False hope. It's a stone.
That shadow up there is moving.
Something far bigger than the school.
The school scattered all at once.
That's a dolphin's whistle.
It's looking at me. Time to move.
The ripples are coming from the wrong way.
Slipping into a gap in the reef.
It's coming this way.
Fins tight, hugging the bottom.

lines.zh: 这一群只剩我还亮着鳞。
lines.en: Of the school, only my scales still shine.
Watching it, not daring to move.
It circles. So do I.
My gills slowed. That's nerves.
If it gets close, I drop deeper.
This hole only fits one fish.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去，减小影子。
lines.en: Turning sideways to shrink my shadow.

lines.zh: 它要是扑过来，我就散开。
lines.en: If it lunges, we scatter.
Every sound in the water stopped.
I've been watching that fin a long time.
Wait. Let it move first.
A smack from my tail.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，只有一点点力。
lines.en: I ram it. Barely any force.
I bite. My teeth are tiny.

lines.zh: 这一下是我全部的力气。
lines.en: That was all the strength I have.
Tail flick, water in its face.
Hit done. Sinking away.
Its hide's too thick. My teeth hurt.
One more ram. Just one.
Fighting underwater is exhausting.
Bit down. Not letting go.
I appear at this depth.
Water just over my back.
Far from shore. Very quiet.
The school gathers from all sides.
The temperature here suits me.
My first tail beat.
Cold ocean. Here I am.
A little light comes down from above.

lines.zh: 我先找个方向，跟着群走。
lines.en: Pick a direction first. Follow the school.
This stretch is empty. Perfect.
The water's hot. I'm darting blind.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在沙上。
lines.en: Flung out of the water onto sand.
No water here. My mouth hangs open.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，肚皮朝上。
lines.en: The blast flipped me belly-up.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进水里，扎中我。
lines.en: Something pierced the water and hit me.

lines.zh: 一股怪力顺着鳞片钻进来。
lines.en: Something strange crawled in under my scales.
So hungry I can't be bothered to swallow.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the water. I went numb.
No water below. Only emptiness.
